summary: UI copy Bets→Workstreams: / and /workstreams show Workstreams; no >Bets< nav labels.
plainSummary: The UI says Workstreams everywhere it used to say Bets.

findings.gap: Nav and list must say Workstreams not Bets: Dual naming confused browse vs ledger language.
findings.plainImpact: People would see two names for the same thing and not know which list to open.

evidence.command: curl -s http://127.0.0.1:3737/workstreams | grep -cE '>[Bb]ets?<' ; curl -s http://127.0.0.1:3737/ | grep -c Workstreams
evidence.observedOutput: Bets label count 0; Workstreams present on / and /workstreams; HTTP 200
